messages:
maya: FYI I'm iterating on a console SLO preview that shows notify fanout + per-route samples when folks tweak thresholds. Need API shape and ops constraints.

simon: Server sim or client-side?

maya: Server-side to use real telemetry, routing rules, quiet windows. Proposal: POST /api/v1/slo/preview {tenant, slo_expr, threshold, lookback, include_capacity?} -> returns raw_count, sampled_count, top_routes, cost_est, snapshot_version, quick.

ali: Two-path: quick path reads compact tenant snapshot (route_map, buckets, sampling_id) for instant feedback; full path enqueues detailed sim resolving escalation trees. Quick path must be tiny and cached.

nora: Add snapshot_version in response. Require experiment/rollout creation to include snapshot_version to avoid drift between preview and applying changes.

simon: Modeling capacity is expensive. Default: deterministic policy-order routing. Provide include_capacity=true to run a cheap capacity-fallback heuristic for full sims.

maya: Privacy: anonymize contacts for users without read access (e.g., show "on-call pager (2)"). Also show confidence_pct and whether sampling was applied.

ali: Rate limits: 10 quick sims/min and 1 full/min per user; also per-tenant caps. Telemetry: emit slo_preview.request{tenant_hash, quick} and slo_preview.result{tenant_hash, quick, raw_bucket, sampled_bucket}.

nora: Queue/backpressure: when worker queue > threshold return 202 + poll_url. UI shows quick estimate then updates with full result when ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Schedule DB schema changes.

maya: Action items: ali to draft OpenAPI + rate-limits, nora to propose snapshot schema and queue policy, sim-ux to wire quick vs full UI + anonymization. I'll collate an RFC after sketches. :thumbsup:
